name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: Outcome-oriented cybersecurity risk management organized around Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover.

requirements.title: Govern
requirements.description: Establish and monitor cybersecurity risk strategy, expectations, policy, and accountability.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved cybersecurity strategy, policy register, accountable owners, governance decisions, and review cadence. A policy without operating evidence is not a pass.

requirements.title: Identify
requirements.description: Understand the organization, assets, risks, and dependencies that require cybersecurity management.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the risk and business context documents, then confirm asset and dependency coverage with current inventory evidence.

requirements.title: Protect
requirements.description: Use safeguards to manage cybersecurity risks and limit the impact of potential events.

requirements.title: Detect
requirements.description: Find and analyze possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises in a timely manner.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking to show detection coverage, alert history, review activity, and unresolved monitoring gaps.

requirements.title: Respond
requirements.description: Take action regarding a detected cybersecurity incident.

requirements.title: Recover
requirements.description: Restore assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident.
